excavation_context.character_description: An adult male grad stadent working as a paleontologist, short brown hair, Latino ethnicity. Wears signature thin-rimmed BLACK aviator lens glasses, a light white tee shirt worn UNDER a khaki safari vest, khaki shorts and brown hiking boots.
excavation_context.stage: Chiseling Brittle Matrix on an Exposed Ridge Face

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_4, wearing his signature black aviator glasses, drives a flat steel chisel into a brittle layer of brownish-black lignite matrix on an exposed badland ridge. The clean split in the layered stone beautifully unveils a large, heavily pitted dermal armor club from the tail of an Ankylosaurus. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
